arxiv-2304-10336.title: Controllable Neural Symbolic Regression
arxiv-2304-10336.creator: Tommaso Bendinelli*, Luca Biggio*, Pierre-Alexandre Kamienny
arxiv-2304-10336.description: Abstract In symbolic regression, the goal is to find an analytical expression that accurately fits experimental data with the minimal use of mathematical symbols such as operators, variables, and constants. However, the combinatorial space of possible expressions can make it challenging for traditional evolutionary algorithms to find the correct expression in a reasonable amount of time.

arxiv-2404-19497.title: Light Cone Cancellation for Variational Quantum Eigensolver in Solving Noisy Max-Cut
arxiv-2404-19497.creator: Xinwei Lee, Xinjian Yan, Ningyi Xie, Yoshiyuki Saito, Leo Kurosawa, Nobuyoshi Asai, Dongsheng Cai, Hoong Chuin LAU
arxiv-2404-19497.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xinwei Lee, Xinjian Yan, Ningyi Xie, Yoshiyuki Saito, Leo Kurosawa, Nobuyoshi Asai, Dongsheng Cai, Hoong Chuin LAU. Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) is a quantum-classical hybrid algorithm used to estimate the ground energy of a given Hamiltonian. It consists of a parameterized quantum circuit, which the parameters are optimized using a classical optimizer.

arxiv-2502-17445.title: Interpretable Dual-Filter Fuzzy Neural Networks for Affective Brain-Computer Interfaces Thanks: Xiaowei Jiang, Yu-Cheng Chang, Thomas Do, and Chin-Teng Lin are with the GrapheneX-UTS Human-centric AI Centre, Australian AI Institute, School of Computer Science, Faculty of Engineering and Information
arxiv-2502-17445.creator: Xiaowei Jiang, Yanan Chen, Nikhil Ranjan Pal, Yu-Cheng Chang, Yunkai Yang, Thomas Do, Chin-Teng Lin *
arxiv-2502-17445.description: Abstract Fuzzy logic provides a robust framework for enhancing explainability, particularly in domains requiring the interpretation of complex and ambiguous signals, such as brain-computer interface (BCI) systems. Despite significant advances in deep learning, interpreting human emotions remains a formidable challenge.

arxiv-2503-14368.title: The Distance to the Magellanic Stream: Constraints from Optical Absorption along Stellar Sightlines Facilities: VLT-UVES [ 8 ] , GASS [ 25 ]
arxiv-2503-14368.creator: Sapna Mishra, Andrew J. Fox, J. V. Smoker, Scott Lucchini, Elena D’Onghia
arxiv-2503-14368.description: Abstract The Magellanic Stream (MS) is a large tail of neutral and ionized gas originating from tidal and hydrodynamical interactions between the Magellanic Clouds as they orbit the Milky Way (MW). It carries a significant gas reservoir that could impact the future evolution of the MW.

arxiv-2505-06677.title: Dynamic feedback linearization of two-input control systems via successive one-fold prolongations
arxiv-2505-06677.creator: Florentina Nicolau, Witold Respondek, Shunjie Li
arxiv-2505-06677.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a constructive algorithm to dynamically linearize two-input control systems via successive one-fold prolongations of a control that has to be suitably chosen at each step of the algorithm. Linearization via successive one-fold prolongations requires special properties of the linearizability distributions 𝒟 0 ⊂ 𝒟 1 ⊂ 𝒟 2 ⊂ ⋯ \mathcal{D}^{0}\subset\mathcal{D}^{1}\subset\mathcal{D}^{2}\subset\cdots .

arxiv-2510-00369.title: The (3+1)-dimensional scalar field model analysis of beam spin asymmetry in the electroproduction of a scalar meson off a scalar target Preprint: Preprint number here
arxiv-2510-00369.creator: Andrew Lundeen, Chueng-Ryong Ji, Yongwoo Choi, Ho-Meoyng Choi
arxiv-2510-00369.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrew Lundeen, Chueng-Ryong Ji, Yongwoo Choi, Ho-Meoyng Choi. We explore exclusive scalar meson electroproduction off a scalar target in the (3+1)-dimensional scalar field model. This model analysis is a straightforward extension of the previous (1+1)-dimensional model analysis presented in Phys. D 105 , 096014 (2022).

arxiv-2510-13840.title: Quantum modeling of radical pair magnetic sensor based on electric dipole moment
arxiv-2510-13840.creator: Mahboobe Sehati, Ali Soltanmanesh, Shabnam Abutalebi, Abolfazl Bahrampour, Naser Haeri, Sareh Rostami, Alireza Bahrampour
arxiv-2510-13840.description: Abstract Photoreduction of cryptochrome protein in the retina is a well-known mechanism of navigation of birds through the geomagnetic field, yet the biosignal nature of the mechanism remains unclear. The absorption of blue light by the flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD) chromophore can alter the distribution of electrons in cryptochrome and create radical pairs with separated charges.

arxiv-2601-07444.title: Formalization of Amicable Numbers Theory
arxiv-2601-07444.creator: Zhipeng Chen, Haolun Tang, Jingyi Zhan
arxiv-2601-07444.description: Abstract . This paper presents a formalization of the theory of amicable numbers in the Lean 4 proof assistant. Two positive integers m m and n n are called an amicable pair if the sum of proper divisors of m m equals n n and the sum of proper divisors of n n equals m m .

pmc-10649911.title: Pharmacodynamic effects of filgotinib treatment driving clinical improvement in patients with active psoriatic arthritis enrolled in the EQUATOR trial
pmc-10649911.creator: Vinod Chandran, Vladislav A Malkov, Kaori L Ito, Yihua Liu, Lene Vestergaard, Oh Kyu Yoon, Jinfeng Liu, Mona Trivedi, Angie Hertz, Dafna Gladman

pmc-12670580.title: Climatic controls on surface albedo and mass balance of Urumqi Glacier No. 1 in the last decade, 2014–2024
pmc-12670580.creator: Hu Yuhan, Wang Feiteng, Zhang Chunxiang, Pan Ruiqi, Du Zhencai, Ming Jing
pmc-12670580.description: SummaryGlaciers in Central Asia are retreating; we analyze how climate controls surface albedo on Urumqi Glacier No. 1 (UG1) using Landsat-8/9 (2014–2024) and ERA5-Land datasets integrated with the Google Earth Engine platform. Multiple linear regression and generalized additive models (GAMs) relate albedo to air temperature, snowfall, and aerosols. pmc-12786111.title: Molecular Mechanisms of Aspartame-Induced Kidney Renal Papillary Cell Carcinoma Revealed by Network Toxicology and Molecular Docking Techniques
pmc-12786111.creator: Chenjie Huang, Lulu Wei, Wenqi Yuan, Yaohong Lu, Gedi Zhang, Ziyou Yan
pmc-12786111.description: Aspartame, a widely used artificial sweetener, has been linked to various cancers, including kidney renal papillary cell carcinoma (KIRP). However, the molecular mechanisms underlying this association remain unclear. This study employed network toxicology and molecular docking to investigate potential mechanisms of aspartame-induced KIRP. Differentially expressed genes from TCGA were intersected with aspartame targets and KIRP-related genes, yielding 61 common targets.

pmc-13214972.title: Evaluating the Efficacy of Monoclonal Antibodies Against a Bioactive Peptide Involved in Alzheimer’s Disease: A Methodological Approach
pmc-13214972.creator: Georgina Bonny, Kashif Mahfooz, Sara Garcia-Rates, Sibah Hasan, Susan Adele Greenfield
pmc-13214972.description: Antibody treatment for Alzheimer’s disease is an evolving therapeutic strategy that ensures high affinity and specificity to the target antigen; however, current approaches have proven only partially successful. A 14-mer peptide, T14, is twice as high in Alzheimer’s brains and has been identified as a primary driver in the neurodegenerative process.

pmc-13225954.title: Clinical and metabolic factors associated with response to postoperative radioactive iodine therapy in Chinese obese patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma
pmc-13225954.creator: Yan Zhou, Yuyue Hou, Shengqing Hu, Chenxi Zhu, Mingjie Zhang, Yuangu Gao, Yajing Zhang, Ji Li, Wei Cao, Zairong Gao, Jie Tan, Xiaotian Xia
pmc-13225954.description: Background and objectiveObesity is a heterogeneous metabolic condition that may influence tumor biology and therapeutic outcomes. However, factors associated with the response to postoperative radioactive iodine (131I) therapy in obese patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) remain insufficiently understood. This study aimed to identify clinical and metabolic factors associated with treatment response in this population.

pmc-13501531.title: Weighted epigenetic site correlation network analysis of chemotherapy impacts on osteosarcoma cancer survivors’ male fertility, sperm, and endocrine parameters
pmc-13501531.creator: Margarett Shnorhavorian, John K Amory, Stephen M Schwartz, Smita Bhatia, Saro Armenian, Holcombe E Grier, Eric J Chow, Rashmi Joshi, Daniel Beck, Michael K Skinner
pmc-13501531.description: The impacts of chemotherapy exposure on adolescent male osteosarcoma survivors as adults were investigated using a number of physiological parameters, with a focus on chemotherapy, reproduction, and sperm. The Children’s Oncology Group (COG) clinical sites (protocol ALTE16C1) of previously collected and stored sperm samples were obtained for this analysis.

uslaw-usc-t19-s2131.description: United States Code, Title 19 (Customs Duties); Chapter 12 (Trade Act Of 1974); Subchapter I (Negotiating And Other Authority); Part 2 (Other Authority). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. uslaw-usc-t36-s20110.title: 36 U.S.C. § 20110 — Liability for acts of officers and agents
uslaw-usc-t36-s20110.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s20110.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 201 (Agricultural Hall Of Fame). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The corporation is liable for the acts of its officers and agents acting within the scope of their authority.
